items.caption: This modern redraw presents 网 as an open frame crossed by lines, matching the net pictograph and oracle-bone examples used for catching game.
items.alt: Black crossed lines form an open, roughly rectangular net shape, with long outer strokes on both sides.
items.selection_reason: It makes the net-like structure visible and helps explain the reported early use of 网 for catching game. The database does not assign absolute dates to the cited inscriptions.

items.caption: This modern redraw shows 网 in a more enclosed seal-script form; the Shuowen account describes its frame and crossed lower lines as a net.
items.alt: An enclosed, rounded rectangular form with crossed diagonal lines in its upper half and long sides descending below.
items.selection_reason: It pairs the net pictograph with a seal-script form discussed in the Shuowen tradition, without implying that the drawing is an artifact or establishing a precise date.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redrawings of script forms, not photographs or direct scans of ancient objects. The reported oracle-bone examples are not assigned absolute dates in the cited account.
